Exchange with Circles.q: How is the value of Circles Points determined?
Exchange with Circles.a:
1 Circles Point can be equivalent to 1 banana.




However, the value of each individual Circles Point can be determined at the time of an exchange, or within a community.

Exchange with Circles.q: Can Circles Points be exchanged for or valued as a currency?
Exchange with Circles.a: No. Circles is not money or a currency. Circles Points cannot be exchanged for any currency. Circles Points are designed as a complementary means to facilitate the exchange of goods/services to support people in meeting their daily needs. Circles Points can only be used by Circles users, and transactions of Circles Points are based on the values of mutual support and mutual trust.

Exchange with Circles.q: How can I exchange for goods or services using Circles?
Exchange with Circles.a: Circles app users can exchange goods/services with Circles Points or a combination of Circles Points and cash. The value of goods/services is determined by the users involved in the exchange. For example, you can agree to give 10 Circles Points or a combination of 5 Circles Points with Rp5.000 for one bowl of porridge. You can also continue to negotiate with the user you are exchanging with to determine the value of the exchange until you have reached a mutual agreement.

Exchange with Circles.q: Can Circles users only exchange Circles Points with other Circles users?
Exchange with Circles.a: Circles users can only exchange Circles Points with other people who are using the Circles application.

Exchange with Circles.q: Why can I not exchange my Circles Point with someone?
Exchange with Circles.a: Before you can exchange Circles Points with someone you need to trust each other on the Circles App.

Exchange with Circles.q: I have registered as a user, but have not done any transactions What should I do?
Exchange with Circles.a: If you are a Circles App user but never use the App, neither you nor your community will benefit from Circles! So, make sure you use Circles Points as often as you can!

Exchange with Circles.q: Can I use my Circles Points outside of my village?
Exchange with Circles.a: Technically you can use your Circles Points to transact with any Circles user anywhere, however if they are far away from you it may make the exchange of goods or services difficult.

Exchange with Circles.q: If transacting parties cannot agree on the value of an exchange what happens?
Exchange with Circles.a: The exchange of goods or services for Circles Points only works when there is an agreement between the transacting parties on the terms of the exchange. You can continue to negotiate until you have reached a mutual agreement.

Exchange with Circles.q: Who determines the value of Circles Points?
Exchange with Circles.a: The value of Circles Points is determined through agreement between the people doing an exchange. The determined value is based on the principle of mutual support and trust.

Exchange with Circles.q: Can Circles support positive social impacts? How?
Exchange with Circles.a:
Yes! Circles has many benefits for community welfare, including: 

Support locally produced products and services 

Economic participation for all (including vulnerable people) 

Help families & communities meet their daily needs 

Increase cooperative strategies in communities 

Support transparency & good governance 

Zero-cost social welfare support 

Increase market access for micro businesses 

Increase community-driven social security 

Support digital literacy 

Help micro & small entrepreneurs grow 

Empower women 

Demonstrate cost-effective UBI strategy for Indonesia 

Stimulate local economic growth

Exchange with Circles.q: Does Circles help community members exchange more goods with each other?
Exchange with Circles.a: Yes. Circles provide complementary means in the form of Circles Points to increase the exchange of goods/services within your local community. Everyday, the Circles app will provide 24 points to each users. This points are provided with the intention to serve as additional resource that can be spent to enhance their fulfillment of daily needs. Users can exchange Circles Points for goods/services with other users based on mutual agreement.

Exchange with Circles.q: Can Circles help fulfill family daily needs?
Exchange with Circles.a: Yes, Circles can help users fulfill their family's daily needs by exchanging Circles Points for goods / services with other users based on a mutual agreement.

Exchange with Circles.q: Can Circles help with my children's education?
Exchange with Circles.a: Circles can support users with the educational needs of their children by providing additional resource in the form of Circles Points. Users can exchange Circles Points for services, such as private tutor with other Circles users that provide that service.

Exchange with Circles.q: Can Circles help me learn new things?
Exchange with Circles.a: As the first technology innovation of a cashless implementation of Universal Basic Income (UBI) in the form of Points, Circles offers the opportunity for new experiences. By using the Circles app, users will be exposed to various interesting concept that combines technological advancement with local wisdom. For example, users will learn how blockchain technology can be used to support the spirit of mutual cooperation and sharing by generating Circles Points that can be used by users to support the growth of their local economy.

Exchange with Circles.q: I don't have enough Circles Points for the transaction I want to do. Can I use a combination of Circles Points & Rupiah?
Exchange with Circles.a: Yes, in addition to exchanging goods/services with Circles Points, users can also use a combination of Circles Points and cash to exchange goods or services with other users. However, it important to understand that the method used and the value of the exchange is based on mutual agreement between the users involved.

Exchange with Circles.q: Who can transact using Circles Points?
Exchange with Circles.a: All Circles app users can transact using Circles Points.

Exchange with Circles.q: How many Circles Points do you get each day?
Exchange with Circles.a: Each user will receive 24 Circles Points every day.

Monitoring.q: What are the different kinds of Interviews I need to do with the research participants?
Monitoring.a:
Interview for recruiting research participants 

Regular interview to gather feedback from the participants regarding the program 

Interview with inactive participants to for problem mapping and troubleshooting 

Interview regarding the impact of using Circles for participants and their family

Monitoring.q: How often do I need to interview the research participants?
Monitoring.a:
(how long?) Interview for recruiting research participants 

Minimum 1 time every 2 weeks mandatory visit to all vendors and at least 10 users for:  
• Regular interview to gather feedback from the participants regarding the program 
• Interview with innactive participants to for problem mapping and troubleshooting 

(When, how many interview per users) Interview regarding the impact of using Circles for participants and their family

Monitoring.q: What do I do if I am confused while interviewing a research participant?
Monitoring.a:
Check the material given to you during the training program 

If needed, reach out to the research team for support and guidance 

If not possible, document what it is that confuses you in a single doc and share it with the Circles Bali team to be discussed promptly 

If it's related to questions from the users and the research team is not available to give support and guidance, document the questions in a single doc share it with the research team to be discussed promptly

Monitoring.q: What is the Circles Team Code of Conduct?
Monitoring.a:
No gratification - may not ask for anything from Research Participants  

Answers entered in the form must match the facts submitted by Research Participants

If you are confused about answering questions from Research Participants, contact the outreach team for support and advice 

No inappropriate content related to ethnicity, religion, race, and inter-group in MSC 

Respectful & Professional 

Represent Circles properly according to the information received during training 

Sharing Research Participants personal data to third parties is prohibited

Monitoring.q: Tips for effective Circles Project monitoring and evaluation
Monitoring.a: Document all the problems experienced by the user, and also the solutions provided. Documentation is highly important for evaluation.

Monitoring.q: How do I fill in the interview forms?
Monitoring.a:
Conduct a one-on-one face-to-face interview with the research participants 

Ask one question to the participant, and wait for their answer before moving on to the next question 

Select/type the answer according to the response from the respondent for each question 

Fill in the form on the spot when you are with the research participants to ensure that you enter the answers correctly according to the responses 

Bring printed questions from the google form, paper and pen for areas with a weak signal (in case the google form doesn't work but you still want to collect the answers)

About Circles.a:
Circles Points are owned by their users, not by an organization or others alike.

Each Circles User has their own personal Circles Points, for example: “Dewi108” receives “Dewi108 Points” from the Circles software everyday.

About Circles.q: How can the Circles Network grow?
About Circles.a: Have a look at this futuristic animation that shows how the Circles network can develop over time with community support.

In essence, Universal basic income (UBI) is a system in which all of the system's participants regularly receive an equal, regular payment of a grant, without any conditions. UBI can be implemented nationally, regionally, or locally. There are many models of UBI in the world.

About Circles.q: How long has Circles been running?
About Circles.a:
The Circles Indonesia project has been doing research and community consultation in Bali since early 2021.  




While variations of the Circles technology have been tested in different parts of the world since 2017, the current version of the Circles application is a new BETA application that will be tested for the first time in 2023.

About Circles.q: How long has the Circles Indonesia Project been running?
About Circles.a: The Circles Indonesia Project was launched just after the COVID19 disaster struck us all. Since that time, the team has been implementing research and consultation with local stakeholders to see how this innovative digital solution may be able to support people in enhancing their fulfillment of daily needs.

About Circles.q: How does the Circles Project evaluate its work?
About Circles.a: The Circles research project works with local research partners to do regular monitoring, evaluation and learning activities through interviewing research participants, documentation and checking data on App usage.

About Circles.q: What are the ethical values of Circles Indonesia?
About Circles.a:
The vision of the Circles Project is to empower all people everywhere to realise joyful, fulfilled, & meaningful lives in which daily needs are met as communities help each other to grow.




The Circles platform is an open source blockchain-based technology that aims to provide digital UBI points that circulate through mutual trust. This community-driven solution aims to support increased use of locally made products and services, as a means to strengthen localised, circular economies. 




As a complementary cashless solution, Circles can advance humanity one giant step into an era of mutual support, sustainable growth and abundance.

How Circles Works.q: What can Circles Points be exchanged for?
How Circles Works.a:
Circle Points can be exchanged for anything two Circles users agree on, such as;

• Products

• Services

• Given as gifts

How Circles Works.q: Where do the Circles Points come from?
How Circles Works.a: Circles Points are automatically created by the Circles software at the rate of 24 Points per user per day. For example: If today there are 100 Circles Users, the Circles Application will create 2,400 Circles Points and distribute 24 Points to each of the 100 users today.
No it isn't. Circles Points are free digital points that are given to users at the rate of 24 points per day. They cannot be exchanged for any kind of currency or cryptocurrency.
No, Circles Points are not money. Circles Points are digital points that are given for free to Circles app users at the rate of 24 points per day. They cannot be exchanged for any kind of currency.

How Circles Works.q: What are the ethical values of the Circles Project?
How Circles Works.a: The Circles Project values cooperation, mutual trust, empowerment, equality and strengthening local communities.

How Circles Works.q: Circles stores data on a Blockchain. What’s a blockchain?
How Circles Works.a: Circles data is stored on a blockchain. A blockchain is like having many sets of identical bookkeeping that are saved in multiple digital locations that don't know each other but all confirm the data, so there is no chance for anyone to tamper with the data. This means the data is very accurate and safe!

In essence, a blockchain is a digital, accountable public ledger that exists across a network. While blockchains are often associated with cryptocurrencies, they are also used for storing all kinds of data.




Some notable uses of Blockchain technology today include for secure voting; for distribution of government benefits; for storing medical information; for noting Digital Art rights (NFTs); for logistics and supply chain tracking and many others!
No it isn't. The Circle Application is currently a BETA (testing) web-based application that is specifically designed for testing by gaining feedback from selected communities in Bali.

How Circles Works.q: Is Circles UBI the same as other UBI Projects?
How Circles Works.a:
No, Circles is quite different from most UBI Projects because most UBI Projects distribute cash funds and are usually given by the government to the people. 




Circles is an independent non-profit initiative that distributes cashless, non-fungible complementary resources in the form of Circles Points.




By distributing non-fungible digital points (i.e. Circles Points cannot be exchanged for fiat or crypto currencies), Circles Indonesia stimulates participating communities to build a localised, trust-based complementary means of exchanging goods and services in the form of points. This means the Circles UBI system can flourish without huge budgets for cash disbursements.

Not yet! At the moment only pre-selected research participants in specific locations in Bali can use Circles Points.




After research is done, then the Project will look at options for collaborations on how it may be possible for other users to start using Circles Points.

On 27 October 2017, the Indonesian Basic Income Guarantee (IndoBIG) Network was established as an informal network of researchers and activists interested in studying and trialling UBI implementation in Indonesia. The IndoBIG Network is committed to provide education in Indonesia regarding UBI developments in the world.




On October 2, 2019, the IndoBIG Network became formally affiliated with the UBI Lab Network based in England. UBI Lab Jakarta was established as part of the Think Tank network between the UBI Lab Network and IndoBIG Network.




You can learn more about UBI in Indonesia through this link.

The idea of UBI been around since the 15th century and had several times found momentum and appeared in world history but then drowned due to economic and political conditions at the time.




For a brief history of thinkers, initiators, and supporters of the idea of "free money for everyone" with their respective backgrounds and arguments see this link.

How Circles Works.q: Is UBI used anywhere else in the world?
How Circles Works.a:
There are growing numbers of UBI projects worldwide…




Read here about the history of UBI, current and past experiments all over the world.

Everyday, Circles application users receive 24 Circles Points. 

For example: today a user has 124 Points, yesterday they had 100 Points.

We certainly hope so! The consultation we conducted with local leaders and communities in Bali in 2021 showed a high level of interest from Balinese communities in using Circles Points to support exchanges of locally made goods and local services.




In 2023 we will learn a lot from the Balinese communities that are testing the Circles application about how these digital exchange points may be most useful in local communities.

How Circles Works.q: How many people are using Circles now?
How Circles Works.a: Currently, Circles Indonesia is implementing a research project with approximately 1500 participants in Bali.

How Circles Works.q: Is Circles easy to understand & use?
How Circles Works.a:
Yes, Circles is easy to use. The Circles app is not far different than any other app that we use everyday. 




We have step by step guide on how to use the app, and if you experience any difficulties or have further questions, you can reach out to our help centre.

How Circles Works.q: Is Circles useful for people with limited funds?
How Circles Works.a:
Yes. All Circles users will receive 24 Circles Points for free, everyday!

These points can be used to enhance people's ability to meet their daily needs by providing additional resources to exchange for goods/services.

When Can I use Circles.q: Can I download/use the Circles application?
When Can I use Circles.a: At the moment only research participants in Bali have been invited to access and use the Circles application. After the research is completed then the Project will look at options for collaborations to see how it may be possible for other users to access Circles Points.

When Can I use Circles.q: When can my community try using the Circles application?
When Can I use Circles.a: After the research being conducted in 2023 is completed, the Circles Project will look at how it may be possible for other communities to start using Circles Points in their area.

When Can I use Circles.q: Who is already using Circles Points in Indonesia?
When Can I use Circles.a: At the moment the only users of Circles Points are selected communities in the Balinese regencies of Jembrana, Tabanan and Denpasar who are participating in the Circles research activities in 2023.

Social Welfare Impacts.q: Is Circles a social welfare Project?
Social Welfare Impacts.a:
Yes, Circles provide Universal Basic Income (UBI) to all people in the form of Circles Points.




Everyday, the Circles app will generate 24 points to each users, inclusive to everyone, regardless of their socioeconomic or geographical background.




The Circles Points are provided with the intention to serve as additional resources to support the fulfillment of daily needs through the exchange of goods/services based on mutual agreement.




Circles aim to provide a complementary cashless solution to all people everywhere to realise joyful, fulfilled, & meaningful lives in which daily needs are met as communities help each other to grow.

Yes, Circles can create new opportunities, especially between vendors.




For example: you can build partnerships with other vendors who provide raw materials needed for the goods/services of your business. This way, you can use Circles Points or a combination of Circles Points and cash for your supply or raw materials.

Social Welfare Impacts.q: Is Circles useful for vulnerable groups (the poor, disabled, elderly etc.?)
Social Welfare Impacts.a:
Circles offers benefit to all people without exception. 




The main goal of Circles is to provide complementary means to support the fulfillment of daily needs through the exchange of goods or services with Circles Points.




The Circles app can be used by everyone at anytime and anywhere, as long as they have smartphone and access to internet. In other word, Circles is given to us simply because we exist.

Social Welfare Impacts.q: Can Circles demonstrate cooperation and trust between people?
Social Welfare Impacts.a:
Circles can be evidence of a trust-based relationship in society.




In order to send or receive Circles Points, both users need to establish trust relation between each other within the app. Only then users are be able to use Circles Points to exchange for goods/services with each other.




If the trust relation is not achieved, the system will not work, and the transaction cannot be carried out.

Social Welfare Impacts.q: Does Circles represent traditional Balinese & Indonesian value?
Social Welfare Impacts.a:
Yes. Circles reflects the principles of mutual cooperation & care "asah, asih, asuh" embodied within the Indonesian traditional value.




Furthermore, Circles is a form of implementation of Tat Twam Asi (I am you, you are me), which is one of the core philosophies of the Balinese community, where we help each other and treat others as we treat ourselves.




Circles' mission is to support the fulfillment of daily needs of everyone based on mutual trust and agreement, not only for themselves but also for others in the local community.

Social Welfare Impacts.q: Does Circles offer a solution for making UBI Initiatives more viable?
Social Welfare Impacts.a:
Yes. Circles is a model that can be an extension of the UBI (universal basic income) program with great potential for an inclusive and feasible implementation.




This type of UBI does not require large cash payments, which are usually borne by the government or individuals, and does not cause/affect overall inflation.




In the world of Circles, everyone can benefit without exception.

Digital Transformations.q: Can Circles help build digital literacy?
Digital Transformations.a: The regular workshops and outreach activities that the Circles Project implements help participants become more comfortable with technology adaptation and learn how they can make digital products useful to their business, personal and family needs.
Yes, the Circles Project is a non-profit digital startup that is currently research ways to support people in meeting their and their family's daily needs.

Digital Transformations.q: Does Circles help people to adapt to technology for the common good and welfare?
Digital Transformations.a: Yes. Circles uses blockchain technology to enhance people ability in meeting their daily needs. By using the Circles app in exchanging goods/services, all Circles users are practicing their technology adaptation on daily basis while working together within their communities to increase the exchange of goods/services based on trust relations.

Economic Impacts.q: Can Circles help build local economic growth?
Economic Impacts.a:
Yes, Circles can help strengthen the local economy because Circles encourages the exchange of locally available goods/services for the fulfillment of daily needs.




Circles users can send or receive Circles Points in exchange for goods/services. Once users setup their business within the Circles App, they can also offer their goods/services through the Circles Market for other users to find.




The daily points provided by the Circles app to each users offers additional resource to enhance the exchange of goods/services within their community. In other words, Circles users can use their cash to meet other needs that cannot be obtained by using Circles Points and allocate their cash for savings and or investments. Therefore, their economic capacity, selling power and purchasing power also increases.

Economic Impacts.q: Can Circles help increase people's income? How?
Economic Impacts.a: People can use Circles to exchange goods/services with other users that accept Circles Points. The Circles Points that will be given to every users, everyday, may increase their ability to fulfill their needs, daily.

Getting Started.q: How do I download and install the Circles App?
Getting Started.a: Circles is a web-based application, so there is no need to download and install anything. Just use an internet browser app and go to http://CirclesUBI.ID to register your Circles account.

Getting Started.q: I have internet problems in my area, can I still exchange Circles Points?
Getting Started.a: Unfortunately not. Circles is a web-based application that needs internet access to be used. Make sure you are in an area with internet access and your device has an internet connection when you use the Circles application.

Getting Started.q: Do I need a phone with special specifications to use Circles?
Getting Started.a: Any Smartphone, android or apple, with a camera.

My Account.q: I can't log into my Circles account, what should I do?
My Account.a: First make sure your cellular data plan is active, or that you have access to a Wi-Fi connection with internet access. Then, try refreshing the https://www.circlesubi.id page in your phone's browser. If that still doesn't work contact your local Circles Support Officer.

My Account.q: I often get logged out Circles without meaning to, what can I do?
My Account.a: If you change your phone or use a different web browser you will need to log in again. This happens mostly when you e.g. open circles via a link from a different application like a messenger and then open it again in your regular browser like chrome, safari or firefox.

My Account.q: I forgot my Circles PIN, what should I do?
My Account.a: Click on "Forgot your pin?" and follow the instructions on screen.

My Account.q: I would like to reactivate my Circles Shop now, how do I do that?
My Account.a:
If you previously deactivated your shop, or it was deactivated by Circles due to Circles Market Shop Policy violation, once it is ready to be reactivated you can easily do so. 




Before you reactivate a shop, please first ensure it has a clear offering for appropriate goods and services to exchange for Circles Points.




To reactivate your shop, follow these steps:

From your shop account, open your PROFILE.

Choose EDIT SHOP from the menu.

Tick ACTIVATE SHOP.

My Account.q: What happens to Circles User accounts if they aren't used regularly?
My Account.a:
Circles reserve the right to delete inactive Circles accounts, and if your account remains inactive (in other words you don't do any Circles exchanges) for 3 months or more it may be deleted from the system.




To prevent this from happening to your Circles account, just log in and start exchanging Circles Points with goods & services offered by people you trust!

My Account.q: Can I create a new Circles account after mine has been deleted?
My Account.a:
Yes! You can always sign up for a new Circles account. Go to https://app.CirclesUBI.id to register your Circles account.




If you have any issues with this process feel free to reach out to the Circles Helpline

My Profile.q: I want to change something on my Circles profile, what should I do?
My Profile.a: Go to the Passport section from the main menu and then you can change your profile name and photo.

My Profile.q: I can't change my Circles profile, what should I do?
My Profile.a: You should be able to change your profile name and photo, if you cannot do this, please contact support from the menu on the left side of the screen.

Wallet.q: I lost my internet connection while I was doing a transaction, what should I do?
Wallet.a: Once you have an internet connection again, go to your wallet and see if the transaction was completed. If it does not show up in your wallet, then repeat your transaction

Wallet.q: I don't think I got my 24 Circles Points per day, what should I do?
Wallet.a: Check your wallet to see your balance history. Circles Points can arrive at different intervals, not necessarily every day. If your balance is wrong, please contact support.

Wallet.q: My Circles transaction failed, but the Circles Points in my wallet decreased. How do I report this?
Wallet.a: Check your wallet to see if the transaction completed or not. If there is no transaction there, then contact support.

Wallet.q: It seems like I didn't get the right amount of Circles points during a transaction, how can I check?
Wallet.a: Go to wallet, and check the historical transaction there

Market.q: I can't upload or change my shop profile photo. What should I do?
Market.a: First make sure your cellular data plan is active, or that you have access to a Wi-Fi connection with internet access. Then, try refreshing the https://www.circlesubi.id/ page in your phone's browser. If that still doesn't work contact your local Circles Support Officer.

Market.q: How do I add a vendor to My Favorite Vendors list?
Market.a: In the circles marketplace, you can click the small “heart’ icon to add vendors shops to your favorite list

Market.q: How many different types of goods and/or services can I offer on the Circles Market?
Market.a: There is no limit to the number of goods/services that users can offer through the Circles Marketplace.

Market.q: Can Circles help increase visibility of my small business?
Market.a: Yes, Circles can help new businesses or MSMEs to promote their businesses. First, you have to set up your business profile in the Circles application. Once created, your business will appear in the Circles Market for other users to find.

Market.q: Why is my shop no longer listed on the Circles Market?
Market.a:
Shops in the Circles Market may be deactivated if:

They offer any products or services that are considered to be illegal or unethical

They do not make any exchanges for 30 consecutive days

They do not provide clear information on the goods & services they offer in exchange for Circles Points




Circles shop deactivation will be carried out on an intermittent basis to maintain a user-friendly market, allowing Circles Users to easily find goods & services to exchange with Circles Points.




If you think your shop has been deactivated by mistake or would like guidance on how to amend and reactivate it, please feel free to reach out to hello@CirclesUBI.id to discuss options.




To avoid shop deactivation and be able to continue offering goods & services in the Circles Market make sure your shop has a clear offering for appropriate goods and services to exchange for Circles Points and to exchange with people in your community on a regular basis.

Market.q: What is the Circles Market Shop Policy?
Market.a:
The Circles Market aims to support communities of Circles Users in finding goods and services that they need to exchange for their Circles Points.




With this in mind, any shops in the Circles Market may be deactivated if:

They offer any products or services that are considered to be illegal or unethical

They do not make any exchanges for 30 consecutive days

They do not provide clear information on the goods & services they offer in exchange for Circles Points




If you think your shop has been deactivated by mistake or would like guidance on how to amend and reactivate it, please feel free to reach out to hello@CirclesUBI.id to discuss options.

Market.q: I would like to reactivate my Circles Shop now, how do I do that?
Market.a:
If you previously deactivated your shop, or it was deactivated by Circles due to Circles Market Shop Policy violation, once it is ready to be reactivated you can easily do so. 




Before you reactivate a shop, please first ensure it has a clear offering for appropriate goods and services to exchange for Circles Points.




To reactivate your shop, follow these steps:

From your shop account, open your PROFILE.

Choose EDIT SHOP from the menu.

Tick ACTIVATE SHOP.

Market.q: Can I and my family list the same shop multiple times in the Circles Marketplace?
Market.a:
Ideally, you should not list the same shop multiple times in the Circles Marketplace as it will make possible users confused about how to contact you to exchange your goods or services for Circles Points! 




It also makes the Circles Marketplace confusing to users. 




We recommend that together with your family you decide which person is the best person to hold the shop account and then the remainder of the people can simply disable the shop in their accounts.

Contacts.q: How can I trust a new friend on the Circles App?
Contacts.a:
Trusting a new Circles friend is easy. 

1. Simply click on your profile picture to access the quick action menu




2. click "Trust New Friend" to search for the friend you wish to add




3. click on "their profile"




4. click on the "arrow button"




5. Trust Successful screen will pop-up

Contacts.q: Who can I invite to use Circles?
Contacts.a: During the research phase of the Circles Project only Vendors will be able to invite new users.

Contacts.q: I can't find a person I want to add as one of my Circles Friends on the application. Is there another way I can add them?
Contacts.a: There are 3 different ways you can add a new Circles contact. As well as searching for their name, you can also scan their profile's QR code or they can send you their Circles ID address via another chat platform (WA, Facebook etc.)

Contacts.q: Can I add a Circles contact from outside of my area?
Contacts.a: Yes you can, however it's important that you know and trust them before you do. Before adding anyone to your contact, make sure that they have the correct name and profile picture, otherwise you are at risk of adding a fake or inactive users, and any Circles Points you get from them may not be useful for you.

Contacts.q: Can I remove someone from my Circles contacts?
Contacts.a:
The contacts section shows all the people that you trust, if you stop trusting someone you should remove them by:

1. Click on their profile




2. Click “untrust”.

Contacts.q: How do I invite someone to join Circles?
Contacts.a:
You can send an invite link to invite someone new to join the Circles platform. 






But it's important that you know and trust them before inviting them as otherwise any Circles Points you get from them may not be useful.

Chat.q: Can I chat someone in the Circles app?
Chat.a: There is no chat function in the BETA version of Circles. We will consider adding this feature in the future.

Help/Support.q: I'm having trouble using the App What should I do?
Help/Support.a:
If you have any issues using the App click on the "Support" link on the sidebar of the App.

This will generate a WhatsApp message to our team and we will do our best to help you as soon as possible. You can also reach out to your local Circles Field Officer

Help/Support.q: How does the Circles Helpline work?
Help/Support.a: You can find the support button on the side bar menu on all pages on the application. Click on it and you will automatically be redirected to WhatsApp to chat with the Circles team

Help/Support.q: I sent a message to the helpline but haven't had a response, what should I do?
Help/Support.a: Please reach out to your local Circles Representative (Field Officer)

Help/Support.q: Can I call someone for help?
Help/Support.a: You can call your local Circles Representative (Field Officer)

Tips for Users.q: What are the requirements to be a Circles User?
Tips for Users.a:
Fully understand that this is a research program and the app is not intended for public use  

Agree to fulfill the commitment as research participants and participate in a series of activities from the beginning until the end of the research program  

Understand and agree to all terms stated in the Informed Consent 

Have a smartphone with an active internet 

Have a working email address 

Have a Facebook account or agree to have a Facebook account created for them 

Understand the value of sharing and is eager to work hand in hand with their community

Tips for Users.q: How is it possible that Circles Points are free?
Tips for Users.a: Circles is a non-profit project that aims to support an innovative UBI digital point delivery system. The project is sponsored by philanthropic visionaries that are committed to seeing how such a system may be of most benefit to communities. Once the project model is fully developed that project will integrate self-sustainability solutions to allow the project to keep developing without the need to burden the end users with any fees.

Tips for Users.q: What can Circles users do with the App?
Tips for Users.a: Circles users can gift Circles to people they care about or exchange items or services for Circles points with other Circles users.

Tips for Users.q: What are the benefits you get as a Circles user?
Tips for Users.a:
The Circles App is free 

Receive Circles Points, for free, every day! (your UBI) 

Use Circles Points for goods or services 

Circles Points can help your family meet daily needs 

You can donate or send Circles Points as a gift 

Circles Points deduces your need to carry & use cash 

Support positive social impact in your community 

Circles is very easy to use once you know how 

Save money by using Circles Points instead of cash

Tips for Users.q: How do I register as a Circles user?
Tips for Users.a: If you are part of the research 2023 program, you will be guided to the sign up process during Circles onboarding workshops. At this point, only selected research participants can join to use the application

Tips for Users.q: Does it cost anything to use Circles?
Tips for Users.a: The Circles app is free and does not charge for anything.

Tips for Users.q: Can Circles help me save money?
Tips for Users.a: Circles can help users to save or even allocate their cash for investment by using Circles Points as an additional resource to exchange for goods/services. Circles Points for each user will increase by 24 Circles every day.

Tips for Users.q: Can Circles strengthen my community's local economy?
Tips for Users.a: Yes, Circles can help strengthen the local economy because Circles encourages the exchange of locally available goods/services for the fulfillment of daily needs.

Tips for Users.q: Does Circles pose any risks for its users?
Tips for Users.a: There are no harm or risks from using Circles app, but please make sure to read the Informed Consent if you have any concerns.

Tips for Vendors.q: What are the benefits of being a Circles vendor?
Tips for Vendors.a:
You receive Circles Points every day 

The Circles App doesn't charge you anything 

Help your customers & community fulfill their daily needs 

Build customer trust & loyalty by using Circles 

Promote your business on the Circles Market 

Support sales of locally made products 

Offer your surplus goods for Circles Points 

Support sales of local services 

Support positive social impact in your community

Tips for Vendors.q: Does it cost anything to be a Circles Vendor?
Tips for Vendors.a: The Circles app is free for everyone to use.

Tips for Vendors.q: I would prefer to exchange something for a combination of Circles Points and Rupiah. Can I do that?
Tips for Vendors.a: Yes, users can exchange goods/services with a combination of Circles Points and cash. However, both users that involved in the exchange must reach mutual agreement.

Tips for Vendors.q: As a participating vendor, can I still exchange goods for goods or services without using Circles points?
Tips for Vendors.a: Yes, as vendor you can choose to exchange goods with goods or services without using Circles Points. However, you will not experience the benefit provided when using Circles Points. For example, increasing the fulfillment of daily needs, cash allocation for savings or investment.

Tips for Vendors.q: Who can Circles vendors receive Circles Points from?
Tips for Vendors.a: Vendors can receive Circles Points from users that they have trusted on the Circles app.

Tips for Vendors.q: How do I register as a Circles vendor?
Tips for Vendors.a:
After creating your basic user account, you can find "create shop" via quick action menu.

1. Click on your profile picture to access quick action menu

2. Click "Create Shop"

Tips for Vendors.q: What are the requirements to be a Circles vendor?
Tips for Vendors.a:
Get a circles invitation from a circles vendor 

Owning a smartphone 

Have an email account 

Connect to the Internet   

Create an account on the Circles web app 

Have goods or services to offer, and be willing to offer these for Circles Points in return

As Circles Vendor, You can offer your products and services on the circles application's marketplace, and promote them there. Find other locally made products and offered services within your community. Support your community members by supporting them meet their daily needs by accepting their Circles Points for your products and services

Tips for Vendors.q: Who determines the value of the goods or services that I exchange for Circles Points?
Tips for Vendors.a: The value of goods/services is determined by the users involved in the exchange. For example, you can agree to give 12 Circles Points for 1kg of apples or continue to negotiate with the user you are transacting with to determine the value of the exchange.

Tips for Vendors.q: Can I use Circles Points to restock my shop?
Tips for Vendors.a: Yes, Circles users can exchange their Circles Points for goods/services with other Circles users that provide the goods/services that they need to restock their shop.

Tips for Vendors.q: How can Circles help me increase my sales?
Tips for Vendors.a: Yes, Circles can help users to increase their sales because Circles provides complementary means in the form of points. The Circles Points given to each user will provide additional resources to support users in fulfilling their daily needs by exchanging points for goods/services from your business. Each user will receive 24 Circles Points every day.

Tips for Vendors.q: Can Circles help me sell my surplus goods?
Tips for Vendors.a: Yes, Circles can help users to sell their surplus goods to other Circles users in exchange for Circles Points.

Tips for Vendors.q: I want to exchange more than one item for Circles. Can I just do one transaction for multiple items, or do I need to do separate transactions for each one?
Tips for Vendors.a: You can do one transaction for as many items as you like with the circles user that you chose to make the transaction with, as long as you have mutually agreed on the amount of circles points to be transferred for the goods/services you require.

Outreach Guide.q: I lost my flip book, what should I do?
Outreach Guide.a:
If you lose your flip book, you can download the PDF version from the Facilitator Resources bank and print it on your own. 




Go to LOGIN menu on the top navigation bar 

Enter the password that has been given to you to access the page 

Look for the media that you want to download. You can also type in the title of the media on the search box 

Click on the Bahasa Indonesia button to download the media 

Print

Outreach Guide.q: How do I find a research participants Facebook profile URL?
Outreach Guide.a:
Go to the participant's FB profile 

Select the three dots at the top of the profile 

Scroll to the bottom of the page 

Select copy link

Troubleshooting.q: A user experienced technical difficulties while using the Circles App, what should I do?
Troubleshooting.a:
Help users to solve the technical problems they experienced when using the Circles App by:




• Sending related infographics or other relevant media for users to read. You can take screenshots of any educational media, including the Circles Application Technical Guide.




• If appropriate, share the question in the user's WA group. This allows other participants to provide answer and participate in the problem solving process.




• If possible, guide the user to solve the problem directly by opening the app together.




Document the problems faced by users in a single doc and share with the Circles Bali team.

Troubleshooting.q: What should I do if a user prefer payment using cash/bank transfer rather than accepting Circles Points?
Troubleshooting.a:
1. Remind the participants of their commitment when joining the research program.




2. Re-explain the benefit of using Circles Points for their business, such as:

Accepting Circles Points or combination of Circles Points and cash for their goods/services

Accepting Circles Points for their surplus goods that would otherwise be wasted

Using Circles Points to restock their supply of raw materials with other Circles users that offers the materials needed

Using Circles Points as bonus / gift for their customer as a form of loyalty incentive or alike




3. Conduct an assessment within the following week to see if the user is willing to accept Circles for their business.




4. If the problem still persist, find another user who is more willing to fulfil the commitment in accepting Circles Points for the goods / services they offer.

Troubleshooting.q: Users do not feel the benefit of Circles for their business, what should I do?
Troubleshooting.a:
1. Ask questions that will identify why the user feels that they are not receiving benefits for their business by using Circles.




2. Remind users that inviting other businesses that offer the goods / services they need to restock their supply can be beneficial for themselves & their community.




3. Re-explain how Circles business model works by showing examples of how they can use Circles Points for their business:

Accepting Circles Points or combination of Circles Points and cash for their goods/services

Accepting Circles Points for their surplus goods that would otherwise be wasted

Using Circles Points to restock their supply of raw materials with other Circles users that offers the materials needed

Using Circles Points as bonus/gift for their customer as a form of loyalty incentive or alike




4. Conduct an assessment within the following week to see if the problem is solved.




5. If the problem still persist, find another user who is more willing to use the Circles app.

Troubleshooting.q: Users don't understand how to use the app, what should I do?
Troubleshooting.a:
Help user to understand how they can use the Circles app effectively by: 




Identifying the functions of the app that the users has not yet understand.  

Sharing related infographics or other relevant media for users to study. If needed, you can take screenshots of any educational media. 

Give an example on how to use the app by conducting direct transaction together with the user  




Document the problems faced by users and the solution provided in a single doc and share with the Circles Bali team.
